thread:
Maya: Quick rollcall — running a seat-scrub for the staggered Wave 7 onboard. Can folks confirm which of their assigned accounts have outstanding enablement sessions and whether there are any renewal-risk flags? Need to finalize outreach cadence by EOD.

Luca: I have a quick list, will paste in a sec. do we want to prioritize by renewal date or by usage drop? :thinking_face:

Priya: renewal date first, usage drop second. If both, mark P1.

Amir: FYI Integrations team found a hanging webhook with NovaHealth — that’s blocking their demo. Marking as blocker.

Nora: I updated the shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet/example (sheet name: "W7-seat-scrub"). Columns: account, CSM, enablement_needed, renewal_date, usage_pct_change, blocker_notes, outreach_owner

Maya: perfect — Nora, can you add a column for "preferred_contact_window"? some of these APAC accounts need local hours.

Nora: added. also added a quick filter for renewal_date <= 45 days.

cs-bot: Reminder: wave7-rollout-check-in meeting scheduled: Tue 10:00 PST. Agenda posted in calendar. :bell:

Luca: pasted the trimmed list below (just the rows with issues):
```
AcmeHealth — enablement_needed: yes — renewal 32d — usage -22% — owner: Maya
Hearthly — enablement_needed: 1 session — renewal 67d — usage flat — owner: Priya
NovaHealth — enablement_needed: yes — renewal 14d — usage -45% — blocker: webhook — owner: Amir
Vaultix — enablement_needed: no — renewal 12d — usage -60% — owner: Luca
```

Priya: Vaultix is high risk — usage tanked after a model swap. I can do a targeted enablement + conf call next Wed.

Amir: I'll take NovaHealth outage with infra. pinging @infra on the ticket.

Maya: assign priorities: NovaHealth P0 (blocker + renewal < 30), Vaultix P0 (usage drop + renewal < 30), AcmeHealth P1, Hearthly P2.

Priya: noted. scheduling Vaultix and AcmeHealth enablement slots — sending calendar invites.

Luca: outreach cadence proposal: 1) immediate triage (owner), 2) enablement session within 7 days, 3) follow-up check at 14 days, 4) health pulse at 45 days. ok?

Maya: yes — add a canned checklist in the sheet (outreach steps) so CS Ops can batch messages.

Nora: done — checklist column added and a prewritten email template in the sheet cell (feel free to tweak).

Priya: can we add an eval prompt set to detect quality regressions after enablement? simple smoke prompts to run before/after.

Maya: yes — add a "post-enablement-eval" task to the sheet. Ops: run eval and attach results to the account row.

Luca: I'll export the P0 list and run a short SMS + email outreach this afternoon.

Amir: infra update: NovaHealth webhook fix ETA 6 hours, will post once deployed.

cs-bot: Ticket #97531 updated by Amir: NovaHealth webhook deployed to staging.

Maya: thanks team. owners: update the sheet as outreach happens. I'll compile a one-pager for the customer success leadership check-in. If anyone needs help with slide snippets, ping me. :thumbsup:

Priya: quick ask — for Vaultix, can we include a short recording of the enablement steps? helps the SEs.

Maya: yes, please record 10–12min and attach link in sheet.

Luca: outreach done for AcmeHealth + Vaultix (emails sent). tracking in sheet.

Amir: NovaHealth root-cause: stale subscription webhook token. fixed and rotated keys. will monitor.

Nora: flagged two accounts in APAC that prefer Wed morning. updated contact windows.

Maya: awesome. closing the loop here — if no blockers by EOD I'll push the outreach cadence to the broader ops channel. Thanks all. :rocket:
